title: chat-wss-00 L197-204: define absent chatIds/contactIds vs null
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00.md L197-204 (ChatStreamEnable example and field text) define chatIds/contactIds null as 'all' but say nothing about an absent field. State whether absent equals null (all) or is invalidArguments. crate-jmap's ChatStreamEnable validator (E4 ephemeral delivery epic) waits on this. Source: crate-jmap spec gap audit 2026-10-19.
notes:
Blocks crate-jmap JMAP-yuut.1 (ChatStreamEnable validator).
DECIDED by Mark 2026-10-20: an absent chatIds or contactIds is equivalent to null (all chats / all known ChatContacts), following the RFC 8620 / RFC 8887 PushEnable convention. Add one sentence to chat-wss-00 §ChatStreamEnable after the contactIds definition.
